description: Ventilation, DHW, distribution, generation, and cooling systems that AuditEngine reads to compute purchased energy. Configure "before" (baseline) and, once retrofit measures are decided, "after" (proposed) — without at least one heating generation source, purchased energy will read as zero on the Results page.

ventilation.title: Ventilation
ventilation.description: At most one natural and one mechanical system are used per scenario.

dhw.title: Domestic hot water (DHW)
dhw.description: Sources feeding the building's hot water demand.

distribution.title: Distribution (pipework)
distribution.description: Heating and DHW pipe runs, used to compute distribution losses. Diameter class must match a seeded pipe-loss reference (e.g. 15-25, 32-50, 65-100).

generation.title: Generation sources
generation.description: What converts distributed heating/DHW need into purchased final energy — without at least one 'heating' row here, the Results page's purchased-energy KPIs stay at zero. Cooling's electricity is computed directly from the cooling system's SEER below, so cooling-endUse rows here are ignored by the engine.

coolingWindows.title: Cooling — solar-gain windows
coolingWindows.description: Windows contributing solar gains to the cooling-season load, by orientation.

coolingSystems.title: Cooling systems
coolingSystems.description: AC/chiller equipment; only the first row per scenario is used to convert cooling load into electrical energy via its SEER.

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.description: Technology-mix fractions should sum to ~1 per zone. Utilization factor reflects control strategy (e.g. 0.3 always-on, 0.55 with presence/daylight sensors).

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Electrical appliances/devices. Cooling-season consumption also feeds the cooling load below as an internal heat gain.

renewables.intro: Renewables (solar PV / solar DHW) aren't tied to a scenario — they represent a proposed addition with no "before" state, so this list applies regardless of the tab above.
renewables.title: Renewables — solar PV & solar DHW
renewables.description: Production is entered as an annual total (spread evenly across months for storage) rather than a month-by-month PVGIS table. It displaces purchased electricity (PV) or DHW energy (Solar DHW) — see the Results page's 'Potential energy use' KPI.
